result.brief: 提出 WAM-OPD，用教师模型对学生 rollout 历史进行视频-动作联合监督的在线策略蒸馏，提升世界动作模型的机器人策略成功率。
result.reason: World Action Model post-training with joint video-action supervision and on-policy distillation; main contribution is robot policy improvement, but involves video world model representation and future video generation.
